payload.reason: The evidence discusses the presence of preserved exposed fossil MIS 5e reef facies at Lembetabe but indicates that the corresponding sequences in synthetic well logs are sometimes lacking, which clarifies the statement about the absence of actual exposed MIS 5e facies.

claims.text: Preserved exposed fossil MIS 5e reef facies are present at Lembetabe, but corresponding sequences in synthetic well logs are sometimes lacking.
The lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs is attributed to preservation bias and sedimentation processes.
